flags.text: exportConversation returns nil for an empty chat or a write failure; exportShareURL stays nil and the Export tap does nothing visible.

Each export writes a new EmuquChat-<timestamp>.md with the full health chat to the temporary directory; nothing deletes it after the share sheet closes (the binding only nils the URL) and Clear conversation does not remove it, so copies persist until OS tmp cleanup or Delete All My Data (DataPurgeService purges temporaryDirectory).
